title: Child in Hooded Coat on Brick Steps, 1950s Suburban B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid mid-century vintage black and white snapshot featuring a young child bundled up in a dark coat with a hood, sitting on brick entry steps outside a stone-clad suburban home. The setting showcases postwar American residential life with trimmed bushes and classic architectural details. The back features a simple photo developer identification stamp 'C793'.
